newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up two cents to 15.02 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up two cents to 15.02 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended two cents up at 15.02 ringgit ($5.95) a kg in tandem with a higher overnight value on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good buying from European and local interests after the higher LME," said a trader. "The market would have gone up further but then selling came on."

There were bids for 149 tonnes against offers of 115, leading to a turnover of 113 tonnes against 122. The local price was at a $10 discount to LME, after trading at par on Monday. -- Barani Krishnaan (603-2307509) ($1=2.5250 ringgit).
